Title: Public Preview: Azure Kubernetes Service desktop

Body.Content:
AKS desktop delivers a modern, application-centric experience for deploying and managing workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service. Built on supported AKS features, best practices, and the open-source Headlamp project, it offers a guided, self-service interface that simplifies Kubernetes operations while preserving control. 


Designed to integrate with existing environments and tools, AKS desktop enables seamless team collaboration through role-based access control (RBAC), helping teams move faster and stay aligned.


Learn more.
